suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require separately diagnosed epilepsy and depressive disorder. Treat as association/risk evidence with acknowledged bidirectionality and shared-confounding potential; do not claim epilepsy necessarily causes depression. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Epilepsy and Major Depressive Disorder
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require separately diagnosed epilepsy and depressive disorder. Treat as association/risk evidence with acknowledged bidirectionality and shared-confounding potential; do not claim epilepsy necessarily causes depression.
